# REDA Hazard Control

> > Industrial safety, fire protection, and security solutions provider serving Saudi Arabia's oil, gas, and petrochemical sectors with NFPA-compliant systems and turnkey EPC services.

REDA Hazard Control is headquartered in Khobar, Saudi Arabia, offering comprehensive hazard control solutions including REDA Fire systems, H2S safety services, VESDA detection, ASME-certified fabrication, and custom rescue equipment. The company maintains ISO 9001 certification and serves major clients including Saudi Aramco with engineering, procurement, and construction capabilities.

## Key Topics

- Fire protection and suppression systems
- NFPA compliance and training
- H2S safety and SCBA equipment
- VESDA fire and gas detection
- EPC (Engineering, Procurement, Construction) services
- ASME-certified fabrication
- Industrial safety for oil and gas
- Maritime rescue and lifesaving equipment
- Passive fire protection systems
- Custom vehicle and trailer fabrication
- Security detection and screening
- ISO 9001 quality management
- Saudi Vision 2030 sustainability
- Petrochemical process equipment

## Fire Protection & Detection

- [REDA Fire](https://www.redahazardcontrol.com/redafire): Fire protection systems: suppression, detection, NFPA training & maintenance
- [Engineered Fire & Gas Detection Systems](https://www.redahazardcontrol.com/engineered-fire-gas-protection-systems): VESDA & advanced fire/gas detection for hazardous industrial environments
- [Passive Fire Systems](https://www.redahazardcontrol.com/passive-fire-systems): Passive fire protection: intumescent & vermiculite systems, fire doors
- [Pipes & Skids](https://www.redahazardcontrol.com/pipes-skids): Custom foam & deluge skids with ASME-certified fabrication

## Industrial Services & EPC

- [EPC Services](https://www.redahazardcontrol.com/epc-services): Turnkey EPC solutions for oil, gas, petrochemical & military projects
- [REDA Process](https://www.redahazardcontrol.com/reda-process): Process equipment for oil, gas, petrochemical: heat exchangers & burners
- [H2S Services](https://www.redahazardcontrol.com/h2s-services): H2S safety solutions: SCBA, gas detection, offshore/onshore equipment
- [REDA Process (Industrial Services)](https://www.redahazardcontrol.com/copy-of-rhc-qatar): Industrial services for oil, gas, petrochemical & mining in Saudi Arabia

## Safety & Security Equipment

- [Rescue Equipment](https://www.redahazardcontrol.com/rescue-equipment): Maritime rescue products including lifesaving & evacuation equipment
- [Security Equipment](https://www.redahazardcontrol.com/security-equipment): Security solutions: detection, screening, smart gates & law enforcement

## Custom Fabrication & Equipment

- [Vehicles, Trailers & Containers](https://www.redahazardcontrol.com/vehicles-trailers-containers): Custom fabrication of specialized vehicles, trailers & fire equipment (NTEA)
- [Power Generator](https://www.redahazardcontrol.com/power-generator): Diesel generators 11-3000 KVA: Perkins, Volvo Penta, MTU engines

## Sustainability & Innovation

- [REDA Green](https://www.redahazardcontrol.com/reda-green): Water management solutions aligned with Saudi Vision 2030 sustainability
- [2022 Events & Partnerships](https://www.redahazardcontrol.com/2022): 2022 events: PPE seminars, UVEX partnership, Rain Bird collaboration
